<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0 -->

# iru_blueprint (Data Source)

Reads one existing Blueprint by exact UUID. Exposes only ID, name and type; no enrollment codes, settings or device inventory.

Supply the exact existing Blueprint UUID. Input UUID spelling is preserved;
`id` returns its canonical lowercase form. Names and partial matches are not
selectors. Missing objects or invalid responses produce diagnostics.

Only `id`, `name` and `type` are returned. Enrollment codes, Blueprint settings,
device counts and inventory are not exposed. This data source does not create
or change Blueprints, enrollment settings or Library Item assignments.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic UUID: replace with an existing Blueprint ID.
data "iru_blueprint" "selected" {
  blueprint_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
}

output "blueprint_name" {
  value = data.iru_blueprint.selected.name
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blueprint_id` (String) Existing Blueprint UUID. Names and partial matches are not accepted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical Blueprint UUID.
- `name` (String) Blueprint display name.
- `type` (String) Blueprint type reported by Iru, such as classic or map.
